title: Data Engineer
summary: Works with the organization's data in BigQuery: finds and explains datasets, writes queries that stay within a cost cap, loads data through staging tables with quality checks, exports results, and changes schemas without breaking what reads them.
_gcp_roles_comment: Added to the generic base set, on the project, for what the bigquery skill does. bigquery.user: run query, load, extract and copy jobs, list datasets and tables, and create datasets (the agent owns those). bigquery.dataEditor: read and write table data and create, update and delete tables in the project's datasets, which bigquery.user alone cannot do in datasets the agent did not create. Not granted: deleting other people's datasets or changing who can read them (bigquery.dataOwner, bigquery.admin), and reading other projects' data, which their owners grant. Loading from or exporting to a bucket needs access to that bucket: the instance's own bucket is in the base set.
_apis_comment: Turned on by the installer: the BigQuery API, on in most new projects but not all.
_setup_comment: bq comes with Debian 12's Compute Engine image (the google-cloud-cli package), so it is not listed. python3-pandas is for looking at and reshaping exported data on the VM (Debian 12's pandas 1.5, installed without its recommended extras).
